hypothesis: Batches that do not fit in buffer_memory were dropped after CRC checks and fetched again. Keeping the framed batches and decoding them when the budget drains removes that repeat download.

results.correctness: Delivered-record, budget, seek, pause, and decode-ceiling tests still pass with framed batches retained.
results.cap: Retained framed bytes are capped by buffer_memory. One non-fitting batch is kept so it is not fetched again. Zero buffer_memory keeps every framed batch.

limits: nb-fetch-gzip-overfetch and nb-fetch-bulk were not re-run, so the fetched/consumed ratio is not yet shown to fall toward 1.
The card stays in progress until that measurement is recorded.
